gloss: in the end; finally; after all that

definitions.gloss: in the end; finally; after all that (with a negative outcome)
definitions.explanation: An expression used when a series of events or efforts leads to an undesirable, disappointing, or absurd conclusion. Strongly implies frustration or exasperation at the outcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧{挙句|あげく}の{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{買|か}わなかった→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: After agonizing over it endlessly, I ended up not buying anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{挙句|あげく}の{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{別|わか}れた→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧。
examples.english: After fighting and fighting, they finally broke up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧{挙句|あげく}の{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: After hours and hours of discussion, they couldn't reach a conclusion.

notes:
USAGE:
{挙句|あげく}の{果|は}て is an intensified form of ⟦{挙句|あげく}→挙句：12709_ageku⟧ (in the end). The addition of ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{果|は}て (the very end) makes it even more emphatic, stressing that the negative result came after a long, drawn-out process. It is always used with negative or disappointing outcomes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Typically follows a verb in past tense or noun + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: 〜⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{挙句|あげく}の{果|は}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (after doing ~ to exhaustion). The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ often follows.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{挙句|あげく}→挙句：12709_ageku⟧ alone has the same meaning but is slightly less emphatic. ⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧ (in the end, after all) is neutral and can precede positive or negative results.
